clue.text: Be like a pachyderm and don't get upset easily

definitions.meaning: elephants and rhinos are known for their tough, thick hides
idiom for being impervious to criticism or insult

explanation.surface: Advice to stay calm by imitating an elephant's stoicism.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is literal for an elephant's hide and idiomatic for a person unmoved by criticism.

clue.text: Very dry except when river floods in

indicators.note: the river's letter pours into the middle of the other word

parts.note: but means except, as in 'all but one'

explanation.surface: A weather report: it's dry apart from when the river breaks its banks.
explanation.definitionFit: Brut is the wine label term for champagne with very little residual sugar, the driest style.

clue.text: Quartet participating in concerts no longer

indicators.note: a run of four letters sits inside the word concerts

explanation.surface: A string quartet that has stopped performing in concerts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that was once so is so in the past and no longer, a synonym in the sense of formerly.

clue.text: See battle trophy being put outside, a sort of shell

indicators.note: the trophy word wraps around the other piece

parts.note: a scalp was taken from a defeated enemy as a trophy
lo is an old word meaning see or behold

explanation.surface: Look at this battle prize displayed outdoors, some kind of shell casing.
explanation.definitionFit: A scallop is a bivalve mollusc whose fan-shaped shell is a classic emblem.

clue.text: Little old peers and VIPs, terribly dictatorial

parts.note: O is the short form of old, so little old is just its abbreviation

indicators.note: used as a sign that the letters of peers and VIPs are badly jumbled

explanation.surface: Elderly lords and dignitaries behaving in a dreadfully autocratic way.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe harsh, tyrannical rule that crushes those under it.

clue.text: Happy to embrace good person, a competitor

indicators.note: the happy word hugs the following pieces inside it

parts.note: content means happy or satisfied
ST, short for saint, is a crossword stock for a good person

explanation.surface: A cheerful rival hugging a fine sportsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A contestant is one who takes part in a competition, a direct synonym.

clue.text: I'd panic with our garb astray — could it be in here?

indicators.note: letters gone astray have wandered out of order, so the fodder is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone panicking because their clothes have gone missing, wondering where they are.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the anagram: missing clothes might well be in the warm cupboard where laundry is dried.
explanation.definitionFit: In British homes this warm cupboard around the hot-water tank is where clean clothes are stored and dried.

clue.text: Artist careered off course in a zone few get to?

indicators.note: veering off course shows the letters are redirected into a new order

explanation.surface: A painter whose car swerved off the road into a remote spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A zone with limited access, such as a military site, is one that few people are permitted to enter.

clue.text: Successful book rep doing more business than the rest?

definitions.meaning: a title that sells in huge numbers

definitions.text: rep doing more business than the rest?
definitions.meaning: read literally, the salesperson who sells most

explanation.surface: A popular title and the top-performing sales representative.
explanation.definitionFit: The term means a hit book, and read literally it means whichever seller tops the sales chart.

clue.text: Mum's upset the little boy

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: ma's is the possessive of ma, a word for mum

explanation.surface: A mother is distressed by her small son.
explanation.definitionFit: Sam is a short familiar boy's name, so it stands for a little lad.

clue.text: Undertaking demand after short time

indicators.note: the demand word comes after the time letter

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to ask is to demand or request

explanation.surface: A job demanded soon after a brief wait.
explanation.definitionFit: An undertaking is a piece of work one takes on, a synonym for a job or assignment.

clue.text: Sheep — not so many in the middle

indicators.note: only the central letters are kept, the two ends being dropped

parts.note: fewer means not so many

explanation.surface: A farmer notes fewer sheep in the middle of the field.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewe is a female sheep, an example of the general word.

clue.text: They may hiss, exerting pressure

parts.note: sounds like snakes or angry crowds, but describes household appliances that release vapour while pressing clothes

explanation.surface: Something hissing and putting pressure on, like a crowd or a snake.
explanation.definitionFit: These laundry appliances let out hissing vapour while being pressed down on fabric.

clue.text: The saint wicked? Is the opposite

indicators.note: a saint turned wicked is changed utterly, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a holy person is in fact wicked, the very reverse of holy.
explanation.definitionFit: An antithesis is the direct contrary of something, its exact reverse.

clue.text: Erotic miss involved in muscle-building exercises

indicators.note: involved here means tangled up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: An amorous young woman caught up in a fitness regime.
explanation.definitionFit: These are exercises where muscles push against resistance without moving, used for strength training.

clue.text: Class enthralled by tutors or teachers

indicators.note: held captive inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A class captivated by its tutors and teachers.
explanation.definitionFit: A sort is a kind or category, the same as a class of things.

clue.text: Stories offering discord reader finally abandoned

indicators.note: the chosen letter is dropped from the discord word

parts.note: friction means conflict or discord

indicators.note: picks the closing letter of reader

explanation.surface: Novels that provoke disagreement, until the last reader gives up.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiction is invented narrative, the collective word for made-up stories.

clue.text: Any number taken on board by one engaged in money matters

indicators.note: the number letter is brought aboard, inside the other word

parts.note: a fiancé is a man engaged to be married
N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.surface: A person absorbed in accounts takes on lots of figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Finance is the management of money, the subject of money matters.

clue.text: Lieutenant to suffer at home

parts.note: to stand something is to bear or suffer it
in means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: A junior officer forced to endure time at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A lieutenant is in its root sense one who holds a place for another, a deputy or substitute.

clue.text: Start to select apparatus for dramatic performance

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of select

parts.note: kit means equipment or apparatus

explanation.surface: Beginning to choose the equipment for a stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: A skit is a short comic sketch performed on stage.

clue.text: Earnest prayers from competitors filled with worry

indicators.note: the competitors word is filled up by the worry word

parts.note: entries are those entered for a contest
to eat is to worry or trouble, as in 'what's eating you?'

explanation.surface: Anxious contestants offering heartfelt prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: Entreaties are earnest requests or pleas, synonymous with heartfelt appeals.

clue.text: Breeze is fine, clearing the head

indicators.note: the first letter is removed from the fine word

parts.note: fair weather is fine weather

explanation.surface: A weather forecast: breezy and fine, good for clearing your head.
explanation.definitionFit: A breeze is a light movement of air, a synonym.

clue.text: Building secured, sealed off at the front

indicators.note: the front letter is closed off and removed

parts.note: shut means fastened or secured

explanation.surface: A building locked up and its front entrance closed off.
explanation.definitionFit: A hut is a small simple building, an example of the wider word.

clue.text: Island in risky enterprise

indicators.note: the island lies within the two words that follow

explanation.surface: An island caught up in a hazardous business venture.
explanation.definitionFit: Skye is one of the Inner Hebrides off the west coast of Scotland.

clue.text: Athlete comes to Scottish peak, having eaten a bit of food

indicators.note: the athlete arrives at the peak, so the peak follows

parts.note: a runner is a track athlete

indicators.note: the peak swallows the letter inside it

parts.note: Ben is used in names of Scottish mountains, e.g. Ben Nevis

explanation.surface: A runner reaches a Highland summit after snacking.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner bean is a long green climbing bean, one item of vegetable food.

clue.text: Essayist producing excellent article in French, revolutionary

indicators.note: turning round signals reading the pieces backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI in crosswords
le is the French masculine 'the'

explanation.surface: A writer produces a superb piece in French about a rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: Elia was the pen name of Charles Lamb, author of the Essays of Elia.

clue.text: Attend bash

definitions.meaning: to be present at, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Split as two words it means to be present at an event; whole, it means to strike hard.

clue.text: Daughter is in grass on blanket

indicators.note: the daughter letter and the word is go inside the grass word

parts.note: to grass on someone is British slang for informing on them, i.e. incriminate

explanation.surface: A daughter lies on a rug spread on the lawn.
explanation.walkthrough: To grass is British slang for to inform to police. 'Blanket' looks like a noun but is an adjective here, as in a blanket ban.
explanation.definitionFit: A blanket measure applies to all without distinction, the same as sweeping or unselective.
